proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item kind
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — no MagicItemRecord exists. The tracer's traceUnit switch has no 'magic_item' branch and would throw. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom, but the surface type system has no corresponding record shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Uncommon — the unit kind is magic_item, which has no entry in UnitRecord

proposed_widenings.name: passive_equip mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: Eyes of Minute Seeing has no activation, no casting time, no use count, no reset cadence. Its effects are always-on while the item is worn. No existing mechanics family (activation, ongoing_effect, triggered_reaction, anchored_trigger, on_hit_trigger) models a passive equip effect. A new family (e.g. passive_equip or equip_effect) is needed for magic items whose mechanics are unconditionally active while worn.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing them, your vision improves significantly — no action, no resource, no trigger

proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense (surface exposure)
proposed_widenings.justification: grant_sense exists in the v4 taxonomy (§9 Effect Atoms) but is not defined in types.ts as a surface type. The Darkvision-within-1-foot effect maps directly to grant_sense, but the surface type system has no GrantSenseEffect variant. The tracer would have nowhere to route it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: granting you Darkvision within that range

proposed_widenings.name: ability_check in RollKind
proposed_widenings.justification: RollKind = 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw'. The Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks effect needs a third variant 'ability_check' (or a typed sub-variant like 'intelligence_check'). The existing modify_roll_advantage shape requires a RollKind[] for its 'on' field, and ability checks are not covered.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to examine something within that range

notes: Two independent structural gaps block encoding: (1) magic_item kind missing from UnitRecord entirely — this alone is disqualifying; (2) no passive_equip family exists for always-on wearable effects. Additionally, ability_check is absent from RollKind and grant_sense is absent from the surface effect vocabulary. The item is otherwise mechanically simple — two unconditional passive riders while worn, no resource or reset cadence needed.
